**Definition:** `cases` is the number of test entries `dotnet test` executed; `methods` is the number of distinct
listed test names in the same four assemblies at the same revision. These are supporting cases, not v0.3 requirement
coverage.

## Named v0.3 coverage (separate, not substitutable)

| Class | Count |
|---|---:|
| Named in v0.3 §12.2–12.3 | 80 |
| `exact-and-executable` (compiled xUnit method, exact name, ≥1 assertion) | 56 |

| `missing behavior` (no executable test and no mapping) | 6 |

Accounted for: **74 of 80**. The six remaining names are:

1. `Contract_GivenAmbiguousUnobservableProse_RequiresResolutionBeforeFreeze`
2. `Contract_GivenModelAttemptToEditFrozenOracle_IsRefused`
3. `AgentLoop_GivenToolError_ContinuesWithObservation`
4. `AgentLoop_GivenStepBudget_FailsWithCategory`
5. `Contract_GivenHumanRejectsProposal_AllowsReproposalWithoutImplementation`
6. `PA02_GivenDifferentBlindRequirement_UsesUnchangedFactoryBinary` (blind; not-run)

The previous delivery record reported 31/80 at round 29. This measurement is separate from that claim, and the map
distinguishes exact names from equivalent behaviour rather than converting renames into coverage. No pass-through
tests were added.

## Reproduce

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File docs/goal-wip-factory-operator-alpha/run-factory-gates.ps1
```

Outputs `gate-report.json` with `passedCases`, `failedCases`, `namedCoverage` and `gate`; it exits non-zero on a
failed suite or a name-only placeholder. `pa01`/`pa02` remain `not-run`.
